visualCharacteristics: Row of icon cards acting as tabs on a dark band with an accent bar on the active card, prev/next arrows when overflowing, and a text panel with title, list label and benefit list.
contentPattern: One row per tab: icon picture | tab label | panel content (first paragraph = title, list = benefits, paragraph before the list = list label, other nodes = text).
usage: Use to present several solution areas as icon tabs, each revealing a descriptive panel with a benefit list.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for tabbed feature or solution overviews by adding one three-cell row per tab.
